description: This file defines an interface 'MessagesTopicPathBuilder' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter'. The interface extends 'TopicPathBuildable' and declares a method for setting a custom subject on a message topic path, used for building or configuring message topics in a messaging protocol.

classes.name: MessagesTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building message topic paths with optional custom subjects.

methods.name: subject
methods.description: Sets a custom subject for the message topic path; returns the builder instance for method chaining.
